cards.name: Adrenaline Shot
cards.text: Before you take a turn, you can use this to gain +4 Speed until end of turn.
cards.flavor: A glass syringe filled with a pungent, glowing amber fluid.

onUse.text: Adrenaline surges through your veins! Gain +4 Speed until end of turn.

cards.name: Amulet of the Ages
cards.text: Gain +1 to Might, Speed, Sanity, and Knowledge while you carry this.
cards.flavor: Ancient silver etched with symbols of power that hum against your chest.

cards.name: Angel Feather
cards.text: A glowing white feather that floats softly. Blesses you with divine protection (+1 Sanity, +1 Speed).
cards.flavor: Pure white, miraculously unsoiled by the dust and decay around you.

cards.name: Armor
cards.text: A breastplate of antique steel. Deflects physical attacks (+1 Might).
cards.flavor: Heavy iron plates that clank with every step.

cards.name: Axe
cards.text: Weapon: Roll 1 additional Might die when attacking.
cards.flavor: Heavy, razor-sharp, with a dark stain along the blade that won't wash off.

cards.name: Bell
cards.text: Ring the brass bell once per turn to calm your nerves and gain 1 Sanity.
cards.flavor: Its pure, resonant tone cuts through the gloom.

cards.name: Blood Dagger
cards.text: A curved, jagged blade thirsty for blood. Weapon: grants +2 Might on draw.
cards.flavor: A wicked obsidian blade that seems thirsty for blood.

cards.name: Bottle
cards.text: An amber glass bottle filled with bubbling liquid. Drink it: roll 3 dice. 4+ Invigorating elixir (Gain 1 Might, Speed); 1-3 Bitter tonic (Gain 1 Sanity); 0 Poison (Lose 1 Might).
cards.flavor: Dark bubbling liquid that smells faintly of almonds.

effects.text: Invigorating elixir! Gain 1 Might and 1 Speed.
Bitter herbal tonic clears your mind. Gain 1 Sanity.
Acrid poison burns your throat! Lose 1 Might.

cards.name: Candle
cards.text: A beeswax candle whose flame reveals hidden secrets (+1 Knowledge, +1 Sanity).
cards.flavor: A steady yellow flame that burns without melting the tallow.

cards.name: Dark Dice
cards.text: Three black dice with crimson pips. Roll 3 dice: 4+ Dark boon grants +1 Might, Speed, Knowledge; 0-3 The dark dice demand payment (Lose 1 Might and 1 Speed).
cards.flavor: They land with unnatural weight, whispering secrets of misfortune.

effects.text: Dark boon! Gain 1 to Might, Speed, Knowledge.
The dark dice drain your vitality! Lose 1 Might and 1 Speed.

cards.name: Dynamite
cards.text: Throw into a room to deal 4 dice of physical damage to all creatures within.
cards.flavor: Three red sticks tied with cord and a short fuse.

effects.text: The dynamite detonates with a thunderous blast, rocking the room!

cards.name: Healing Salve
cards.text: Restore up to 2 steps to any trait.
cards.flavor: A pungent herbal paste that immediately numbs pain and stops bleeding.

then.text: The soothing salve restores 2 steps to the chosen trait.

cards.name: Idol
cards.text: A golden idol of a forgotten deity. Make a Sanity roll: 4+ Divine blessing (+1 to all traits!); 0-3 Dark curse (Lose 1 Sanity).
cards.flavor: The idol's eyes seem to follow you everywhere you turn.

effects.text: The golden idol radiates divine light! All traits increased by 1!
A dark curse drains your spirit. Lose 1 Sanity.

cards.name: Lucky Stone
cards.text: A smooth river stone that hums with good fortune (+1 Speed, +1 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Smooth jade that feels pleasantly cool in your palm.

cards.name: Medical Kit
cards.text: A leather satchel of bandages and salves. Make a Knowledge roll: 4+ Expert care (Gain 2 Might); 1-3 Basic care (Gain 1 Might); 0 Fumbled.
cards.flavor: Bandages, antiseptic, and surgical tools in a leather case.

effects.text: You bandage your wounds expertly. Gain 2 Might.
You dress your cuts. Gain 1 Might.
You fail to bandage properly.

cards.name: Music Box
cards.text: A tarnished brass music box with a dancing skeleton. Play melody: make a Sanity roll: 4+ Soothing tune (Gain 1 Sanity); 0-3 Agonizing discord (Lose 1 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Inlaid with mother-of-pearl, playing a bittersweet melody.

effects.text: A sweet, calming melody soothes your frayed nerves. Gain 1 Sanity.
Discordant, agonizing chimes ring out! Lose 1 Sanity.

cards.name: Pickpocket's Gloves
cards.text: Soft leather gloves with supple fingertips (+1 Speed, +1 Knowledge).
cards.flavor: Supple black leather that moves like a second skin.

cards.name: Puzzle Box
cards.text: An intricate puzzle box of polished bone. Make a Knowledge roll: 6+ Crack the box open (Gain 2 Knowledge, Gain 1 Might); 0-5 Remains sealed.
cards.flavor: Intricate sliding wooden panels with geometric carvings.

effects.text: Click! The puzzle box springs open! Gain 2 Knowledge and 1 Might.
The puzzle box carvings refuse to align (requires 6+ Knowledge).

cards.name: Rabbit's Foot
cards.text: A lucky rabbit foot (+1 Speed on draw).
cards.flavor: Frayed grey fur on a tarnished brass chain.

cards.name: Revolver
cards.text: A heavy six-shooter with steel cylinder. Ranged weapon: grants +2 Might on draw.
cards.flavor: A heavy steel six-shooter, fully loaded with lead bullets.

cards.name: Sacrificial Dagger
cards.text: An obsidian ceremonial dagger inscribed with runes. Weapon: grants +2 Might on draw, but lose 1 Sanity.
cards.flavor: Wavy kris blade engraved with sinister occult glyphs.

cards.name: Smelling Salts
cards.text: Wake a stunned explorer or restore 1 Sanity.
cards.flavor: A small glass vial that clears the fog from your mind with sharp ammonia fumes.

then.text: The pungent smelling salts clear the explorer head and restore 1 Sanity.

cards.name: Bite
cards.text: A shadow lunges at you! Make a Might roll: 4+ You fend it off; 1-3 Flesh wound (Lose 1 Might); 0 Savage mauling (Lose 2 Might).
cards.flavor: Something scuttled out of the shadows and clamped onto your ankle.

cards.name: Book
cards.text: Ancient tome bound in aged calfskin. Gain 2 Knowledge; make a Haunt roll.
cards.flavor: The pages describe rituals in languages thought lost millennia ago.

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.text: Gazing into the orb reveals hazy visions of what is to come. Once per turn, make a Knowledge roll: 4+ Cosmic insight (Gain 1 Knowledge); 1-3 Swirling mists; 0 Demonic vision (Lose 1 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Cold quartz that swirls with ghostly figures and weeping faces.

effects.text: The crystal ball clears, imparting forbidden knowledge! Gain 1 Knowledge.
Swirling mists reveal nothing.
A terrifying demon stares back at you from the orb! Lose 1 Sanity.

cards.name: Dog
cards.text: A friendly companion. Gain +1 Might and +1 Sanity. Make a Haunt roll.
cards.flavor: A mangy golden retriever trotting happily out from under a table.

cards.name: Girl
cards.text: A frightened child hiding in the shadows. Gain +1 Sanity and +1 Knowledge. Make a Haunt roll.
cards.flavor: She clutches your sleeve in silence, terrified of the house.

cards.name: Holy Symbol
cards.text: A consecrated icon. Gain +2 Sanity. Make a Haunt roll.
cards.flavor: Warmth spreads through your fingers as you clutch the cross.

cards.name: Madman
cards.text: A wild-eyed hermit joins you. Gain +2 Might, but lose 1 Sanity. Make a Haunt roll.
cards.flavor: He gibbers prophecies of doom while violently brandishing a club.

cards.name: Mask
cards.text: A somber mask with obsidian eyes. When you put it on, make a Sanity roll: 4+ Ancient wisdom (Gain 2 Knowledge); 1-3 Faint whispers; 0 Maddening agony (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: A tragic visage that seems almost alive as shadows shift across it.

effects.text: Cosmic wisdom fills your thoughts! Gain 2 Knowledge.
The mask whispers ancient syllables that fade away.
The mask claws into your mind! Lose 2 Sanity.

cards.name: Medallion
cards.text: An embossed bronze talisman. Protects its bearer against the dark house (+1 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Heavy bronze that glows softly in the presence of malevolence.

cards.name: Ring
cards.text: A band of cold, dark silver adorned with a pale gem. Enhances mental fortitude (+1 Sanity). Formidable weapon in combat.
cards.flavor: The stone pulses like a slow heartbeat against your skin.

cards.name: Skull
cards.text: A lacquered human skull with hollow eyes. Lose 1 Sanity on draw. Use to commune with the dead: roll Sanity 4+ Gain 1 Knowledge; 0-3 Lose 1 Sanity.
cards.flavor: Its hollow eye sockets seem fixed on yours with grim malice.

effects.text: The skull whispers memories of its past life. Gain 1 Knowledge.
The skull chatters mockingly, shaking your resolve. Lose 1 Sanity.

cards.name: Spear
cards.text: A rusted iron spear bathed in ancient blood. Powerful weapon (+2 Might on draw).
cards.flavor: A bronze tip that has tasted royal blood in centuries past.

cards.name: Spirit Board
cards.text: A wooden planchette rests upon alphabet letters. Once per turn, make a Knowledge roll: 4+ Benign spirits guide you (Gain 1 Knowledge, Gain 1 Sanity); 1-3 Gibberish; 0 Malevolent wails (Lose 1 Sanity).
cards.flavor: The planchette slides smoothly across letters without any human hand touching it.

effects.text: The planchette glides smoothly, revealing benign secrets! Gain 1 Knowledge and 1 Sanity.
The planchette spells gibberish and halts.
The board screams in a chorus of dead souls! Lose 1 Sanity.

cards.name: Something Slimy
cards.text: Something cold and gelatinous brushes against your legs! Make a Might roll: 4+ You pull away safely. 1-3 It clings to you (Lose 1 Speed). 0 It drags you down (Lose 2 Speed).
cards.flavor: A foul-smelling mucus coats your boots as you scramble back.

cards.name: Burning Man
cards.text: A figure engulfed in raging flames rushes screaming past you! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You stand firm. 2-3 You reel in terror (Lose 1 Sanity). 0-1 You scream in panic (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: The heat scorches your eyebrows, yet leaves no ash upon the floor.

cards.name: Whoops!
cards.text: You trip over a broken floorboard! Make a Speed roll: 3+ You regain balance. 0-2 You crash painfully (Lose 1 Speed).
cards.flavor: Wood splinters beneath your boots as you crash to the ground.

cards.name: Smoke
cards.text: Thick acrid smoke fills your lungs. Make a Might roll: 4+ You cough but push through. 1-3 You choke (Lose 1 Might). 0 You collapse coughing (Lose 2 Might).
cards.flavor: Black soot clings to your throat and stings your tearful eyes.

cards.name: Skeletons
cards.text: Skeletal hands reach out from the walls trying to pull you into the dark! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ Nerves of steel. 1-3 Panic sets in (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Terrified (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Dry bones rattle with sickening clatter all around you.

cards.name: Spider
cards.text: A hairy spider the size of a dinner plate drops onto your shoulder! Make a Speed roll: 4+ You dodge swiftly. 1-3 It bites your arm (Lose 1 Might). 0 Venom courses through you (Lose 2 Might).
cards.flavor: Venom burns like acid through your veins.

cards.name: Angry Being
cards.text: A furious specter bellows in rage, chilling you to the bone! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You endure the roar. 1-3 Chilled to the soul (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Paralyzing dread (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Its hollow scream reverberates inside your skull.

cards.name: Hideous Shriek
cards.text: An ear-splitting shriek pierces the dark corridors! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You cover your ears in time. 1-3 Piercing ringing (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Eardrums burst (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: You clap your hands over your bleeding ears, trembling.

cards.name: Something Hidden
cards.text: You notice a secret hollow in the paneling containing ancient research! Make a Knowledge roll: 4+ Ancient occult treatise (Gain 2 Knowledge). 1-3 Useful blueprints (Gain 1 Knowledge). 0 The text has rotted away.
cards.flavor: Mouldering manuscripts describe the history of this accursed estate.

cards.name: Locked Safe
cards.text: An iron safe embedded in the brickwork. Make a Knowledge roll: 4+ You crack the tumblers (Gain 1 Knowledge, Gain 1 Might). 1-3 You study the mechanism (Gain 1 Knowledge). 0 The lock is rusted solid.
cards.flavor: Tumblers click in heavy sequence beneath your careful touch.

cards.name: Disquieting Sounds
cards.text: Wet footsteps shuffle behind you! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You master your fears (Gain 1 Sanity). 1-3 Creeping paranoia (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Total panic (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: You spin around with flashlight raised, but only shadows stare back.

cards.name: Image in the Mirror
cards.text: Your reflection turns and laughs cruelly before decaying into dust! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You recognize the trick. 1-3 Shaken (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Broken psyche (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: The glass shivers, showing horrors that have not yet occurred.

cards.name: Groundskeeper
cards.text: A hulking phantom in muddy overalls strikes with a rusty shovel! Make a Might roll: 4+ You deflect the shovel (Gain 1 Might). 1-3 A glancing blow (Lose 1 Might). 0 Heavy blow (Lose 2 Might).
cards.flavor: He dissolves into autumn leaves as his blade clatters on the stone.

cards.name: Mist from the Walls
cards.text: Freezing mist seeps through cracks, numbing your legs! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You hold your breath. 1-3 Shivering cold (Lose 1 Speed). 0 Frostbite (Lose 2 Speed).
cards.flavor: Frost crystallizes across the floorboards in intricate spiderwebs.

cards.name: The Voice
cards.text: A sweet, disembodied whisper shares hidden truths of the house. Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You absorb the arcane secrets (Gain 2 Knowledge). 1-3 You learn a useful secret (Gain 1 Knowledge). 0 Maddening babble (Lose 1 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Secrets of the architecture and ancient architects flow into your thoughts.

cards.name: Phone Call
cards.text: An antique rotary phone rings. A dead loved one whispers your name! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ A loving message calms you (Gain 1 Sanity). 1-3 Chilling sobs (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 A prophecy of doom (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: The cord has been cut clean through, yet the bell still tolls.

cards.name: Rotten
cards.text: Foul fungal stench fills the room! Make a Might roll: 4+ You fight off nausea. 1-3 You retch violently (Lose 1 Might). 0 Choking spores (Lose 2 Might).
cards.flavor: Black mold drips down the peeling floral wallpaper.

cards.name: The Walls
cards.text: Blood begins weeping from the plaster seams! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You ignore the gore. 1-3 Sickened (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Hysterical horror (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Warm red rivulets streak down the painted portraits.

cards.name: Hanged Men
cards.text: Gallows ropes swing from the ceiling with shadowy figures! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You remain steady. 1-3 Shudder in dread (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Terrifying hallucination (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Hemp creaks against timber in a breeze that shouldn't exist indoors.

cards.name: Funeral
cards.text: You see mourners gathered around a mahogany casket bearing your own photo! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You dispel the macabre vision. 1-3 Morbid dread (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Crushing despair (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Black veils turn in unison to stare through you with empty eyes.

cards.name: Creepy Crawlies
cards.text: Thousands of centipedes and beetles drop from the ceiling onto you! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You brush them off unflinchingly. 1-3 Repulsed and bitten (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Swarmed in darkness (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Tiny pincers and tickling legs swarm through your collar and hair.

cards.name: Closet Door
cards.text: A cupboard door swings open, revealing a stash of old medical supplies! Make a Knowledge roll: 4+ Pristine apothecary restoratives (Gain 1 Might, Gain 1 Speed). 1-3 Clean bandages and salves (Gain 1 Might). 0 Empty jars.
cards.flavor: Salves and bandages preserved in amber apothecary jars.

cards.name: Bloody Vision
cards.text: The entire room suddenly appears drenched in fresh arterial blood, then vanishes! Make a Sanity roll: 4+ You look away in time. 1-3 Heart palpitations (Lose 1 Sanity). 0 Overcome with gore (Lose 2 Sanity).
cards.flavor: Metallic copper taste fills your mouth as you gasp in terror.

cards.name: Night View
cards.text: A window reveals the majestic moonlit estate, calming your racing heart. Gain 1 Sanity.
cards.flavor: Silver moonlight cuts through the gloom, giving you renewed hope.

cards.name: Ground Tremors
cards.text: The foundations shake violently as if something massive is stirring beneath! Make a Speed roll: 4+ You keep your footing. 1-3 You stumble hard (Lose 1 Speed). 0 You crash violently to the floor (Lose 2 Speed).
cards.flavor: Plaster dust rains down as stones grind against each other.
